title: malope malacoides var. hispida
intro: Malope malacoides var. hispida, commonly known as the rough-fruited or hispid Malope, is a plant species that belongs to the Malpighiaceae family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Malope malacoides var. hispida include reducing fever, alleviating pain, and treating skin conditions such as eczema and acne. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
